content:
This is a good point, until we find out that the Americans and Russians have already been doing this since the 1950s. EM/MHD vehicles, lasers, and fusion. After that, it's easy to achieve controlled plasma and stealth technology.  #UFO #UFOtwitter

Learn from the patents below 

Plasma Stealth Drone

Russian patent (RU2565157C1, granted in 2015) for a drone designed with plasma stealth technology. The key idea is to reduce radar visibility (radar cross-section) by generating a plasma cloud around the front fairing/nose of the drone. 

Drone using Plasma Generators/Actuators

Over-wing traveling-wave axial flow plasma accelerator," US8006939B2, by Paul D. McClure and Charles J. Chase, assigned to Lockheed Martin) creates ionized fluid (plasma) over a wing or surface. 

Primary purpose: Manipulate airflow to:

Reduce drag.

Improve lift-to-drag (L/D) ratio.

Keep flow attached (prevent stall).

Reduce noise.

Generate thrust for propulsion or flow control around the vehicle.

Drone using Air-breathing Propulsion

Patent (RU2706760C1)

Type: Unmanned or experimental aircraft in a "flying wing" aerodynamic scheme.

Propulsion: It features a power plant with jet engines (реактивных двигателей in Russian) and an air intake device (воздухозаборное устройство) that can rotate.

Air-breathing nature: The design explicitly relies on air intakes to feed atmospheric air into the engines for combustion. This is typical of turbojet or similar air-breathing jet propulsion, not rocket propulsion (which carries its own oxidizer).

The patent focuses on improving aerodynamics across flight modes and reducing radar visibility (stealth features), with a thrust vector control system tied to the movable air intakes.

It's an air-breathing jet-powered stealthy flying-wing drone/UAV concept. 

There are all kinds of propulsions and vehicles in existence of which we don't know about that are classified since 1950s alongside cold and hot fusion.
